name: Rim exit devices named in the Von Duprin 6100 strike compatibility table
closure_criterion: NONE - this is a seed, not a closed set.
source_locator: p.2, 'Rim Exit Device Compatibility for 6111, 6112, 6113 and 6121 Strikes'
status: SEED - ACTIVE FOR NARROWING, NOT FOR PROMOTION
notes: READ THIS BEFORE USING THE SET. is_complete is FALSE and must stay FALSE. This table lists the devices ONE STRIKE works with - it is not an enumeration of the rim exit device market. Any manufacturer that makes a rim exit device but is not 6100-compatible, or was simply not listed, is absent. Under registry Section 9 a claim tested only against this set is capped and reports blocked_by_incomplete_sibling_set. The set is genuinely useful for KILLING candidates - one collision inside it is fatal regardless of completeness - and useless for confirming them.

name: Grade 1 rim exit devices - target closed cross-manufacturer set
closure_criterion: Every manufacturer listed in the BHMA Certified Products Directory as certifying a Grade 1 rim exit device to ANSI/BHMA A156.3, as of a stated retrieval date, together with every such device that manufacturer lists.
may_support_promotion: YES, once enumerated and is_complete set TRUE
notes: This is the set that can eventually license a manufacturer-tier claim. CS-XM-001 is a SUBSET of it. Populating it is a directory retrieval, not a judgement call - which is exactly why it is closable. Realistic size for Grade 1 rim: six to ten manufacturers.

name: Von Duprin rim exit devices named in the same 6100 table
closure_criterion: NONE - subset of one compatibility table, not the Von Duprin rim catalogue.
status: SEED - SIBLING SCOPE, KEPT SEPARATE ON PURPOSE
notes: Held separately so nobody mixes scopes. 22, 33A, 35A, 55, 88, 98 and 99 are all Von Duprin, so pairs among them are sibling comparisons, NOT cross-manufacturer ones. A feature verified here can never support a manufacturer claim. Note the archive also holds 75, 78 and the 94/95 INPACT families, which this table does not list - further evidence the set is not closed.
